verdict.rationale: Docs confirm machines can be created and managed programmatically via API/CLI (paperspace-docs-1, -6, -23, -24, -30) and that auto-shutdown can stop idle machines to control cost (paperspace-docs-5), plus hourly/on-demand billing is implied (paperspace-docs-26, comm-8). However, no evidence explicitly documents start/stop/restart/terminate API endpoints or CLI commands by name, and community feedback (paperspace-comm-7) notes friction with core VM management. Missing for 10: explicit API/CLI reference for start/stop/restart/terminate actions, and independent confirmation that programmatic lifecycle control reliably ties to billing.
